differences: The paper reports 87 participants for the online Experiment 1B; the deposit's no-feedback file has 50 and also holds rotated-clamp and large-jump trials, so it is converted as the no-feedback control and its identification with Experiment 1B is not certain.

Outlier removal: the paper reports 0.2 +- 0.2 % of trials per participant for Exp 1 and 0.1 +- 0.2 % for Exp 2; the deposit's missing Hand values give about 0.14 % (Exp 1A) and 0.23 % (Exp 2), and 1.1 % +- 0.8 (not +- 0.1) for Exp 4, so only the Exp 3 and Exp 4 means are listed as reproduced.
Positive = counter-clockwise is inferred from the paper's Fig 5 legend and from the direction of the hand change; the deposit has no readme.
